label: General concepts
definition: Part 1 defines the facility and infrastructure decomposition used in the series; it does not require a register of capabilities.

label: General concepts (availability classes)
definition: Availability classes express the required availability of the infrastructure. AIDCF Service Outcomes are capability-level, with tolerances for performance, integrity and recovery, and are not reducible to a class.

label: General concepts (business risk analysis; availability and protection classes)
definition: Business risk analysis linking business impact to class selection overlaps criticality criteria and priority classification.

label: General concepts; Management and operational information (capacity management)
definition: Capacity planning appears as an operational process; peak, transient and scenario demand for AI loads are not addressed.

label: Environmental control
definition: Environmental conditions for spaces overlap the environmental envelope; load, duration and state-specific limits are AIDCF parameters.

label: General concepts (design process phases); Management and operational information
definition: The design-phase model and operational information support design-to-operation traceability; commissioning acceptance against Service Outcomes is not defined.

label: IT equipment utilisation KPI
definition: IT-equipment KPIs in the 4-x series measure server energy efficiency and utilisation; part numbers and applicability to accelerators should be confirmed by a licensed holder.

label: Power distribution; Environmental control
definition: Supply and distribution chains are described per infrastructure; asset-to-function and recovery-dependency mapping are not required.

label: Power distribution; Environmental control (availability-class topology)
definition: Higher availability classes reduce single points of failure in paths; common controllers, shared routes and shared human dependencies are not analysed.

label: Power distribution (supply); Telecommunications cabling infrastructure (access provider entrance)
definition: Utility supply and telecom entrance provisions overlap utility and telecom dependency; OEM and cloud dependency are out of scope.

label: Environmental control
definition: Temperature, humidity and contamination control for spaces overlaps; vibration and acoustic conditions are not central.

label: KPI overview; Power usage effectiveness; Cooling efficiency ratio
definition: PUE measurement and KPI framework overlap strongly. Energy allocation to Capability Instances and the resilience-efficiency trade-off are AIDCF-specific.

label: Water usage effectiveness
definition: WUE measurement overlaps; water-source quality, scarcity response and discharge control are not addressed.

label: Renewable energy factor; Carbon usage effectiveness
definition: Renewable and carbon KPIs overlap; accounting boundary, energy-attribute evidence and embodied resource data are not addressed.

label: Recommended practices for environmental sustainability
definition: Technical report (informative); no hazardous-materials handling requirements.
Climate adaptation is not addressed in the parts listed; site hazard assessment under EN 50600-2-1 is a partial input (see PHY-01).

label: Management and operational information
definition: Operational information and documentation are a source of evidence; no evidence architecture.

label: Management and operational information
definition: Part 3-1 assigns responsibilities within operational and management processes; it does not address critical-function accountability, risk-acceptance authority or evidence custody.

label: General concepts (business risk analysis)
definition: The business risk analysis that drives availability and protection class selection is a context for risk appetite linkage; there is no assurance plan or independent review requirement.

label: Telecommunications cabling infrastructure
definition: Cabling topology and redundancy by availability class; scale-up and scale-out fabric design is out of scope.

label: Telecommunications cabling infrastructure
definition: Cabling infrastructure, pathways and administration overlap strongly; optics compatibility for AI fabrics is not addressed.

label: Management and operational information
definition: Operational organisation and roles overlap; 24x7 coverage levels and competence authorisation need site evidence.

label: Management and operational information
definition: Operational procedures overlap SOPs and work control; permit to work and lockout/tagout are governed by safety regulation.

label: Management and operational information
definition: Maintenance processes overlap; deferred-maintenance governance is AIDCF-specific.

label: Management and operational information
definition: Incident and problem processes overlap; alarm rationalisation is not addressed.

label: Management and operational information
definition: Change and configuration processes overlap.

label: Management and operational information
definition: Capacity and service-level processes overlap.

label: Building construction (location and site)
definition: Site location and external risk considerations overlap site hazard assessment and external exposure.

label: Building construction
definition: Building construction requirements overlap structural capacity and building envelope; rack loading and anchorage for high-density AI racks should be verified against the as-built design.

label: Building construction; Security systems (protection classes)
definition: Protection classes and space segregation overlap security and fire zones; tenant segregation is not specifically addressed.

label: Security systems
definition: Physical access control, intrusion detection and surveillance overlap strongly; alarm-response performance is an operational matter.

label: Management and operational information
definition: Asset management processes are a context; delivery, movement and media custody controls are not specified.

label: Security systems (protection against fire and other events)
definition: Fire detection and suppression provisions overlap; life safety, egress and emergency shutdown remain governed by national fire and building regulation.

label: Power distribution (supply)
definition: Utility supply provisions by availability class overlap utility capacity and connection reliability; grid quality and utility contingency need site evidence.

label: Power distribution (supply)
definition: Secondary and standby supply provisions overlap generation; fuel autonomy and replenishment are parameters for the capability profile.

label: Power distribution
definition: Uninterruptible supply provisions overlap UPS topology; battery condition, runtime derating and bypass exposure need operational evidence.

label: Power distribution
definition: Distribution topology overlaps switchgear and busway/PDU capacity; selective coordination and earthing require protection studies.

label: Power distribution
definition: Power quality is a design consideration; transient ride-through and load-step response for AI training loads are AIDCF-specific.

label: Power distribution (energy efficiency enablement and metering); Management and operational information
definition: Metering granularity and operational processes overlap EPMS coverage and preventive maintenance; black-start and restoration are not addressed.

label: General concepts (availability classes)
definition: Availability classes express a resilience intent for infrastructure; minimum service outcome and graceful degradation of AI capability are AIDCF-specific.

label: Building construction; Power distribution; Environmental control
definition: Compartmentation and availability-class topology contribute to containment; fault-domain definition across compute, storage and network is not addressed.

label: Management and operational information
definition: Continuity is touched by operational processes; site and provider continuity strategy is not specified.

label: Management and operational information
definition: Recovery from incidents is an operational process; recovery sequencing across facility and AI infrastructure is AIDCF-specific.

label: Management and operational information
definition: Spares may be addressed within maintenance and asset processes; lead times and obsolescence planning are not.

label: Environmental control
definition: Cooling capacity and redundancy by availability class overlap design and resilient capacity; heat-load models for AI densities and seasonal derating need site evidence.

label: Environmental control
definition: Air-side environmental control overlaps airflow management and containment.

label: Environmental control
definition: Coverage of direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs and secondary loops in the edition in use requires confirmation by a licensed holder.

label: Environmental control
definition: Heat rejection plant overlaps chiller and dry-cooler capacity; water continuity and heat-rejection dependency need site evidence.

label: Environmental control; Security systems (protection against water)
definition: Protection against water ingress and leakage overlaps leak detection; coolant compatibility and water quality are not addressed.

label: Environmental control; Management and operational information
definition: Monitoring and operational processes overlap; control stability, sensor trust and thermal recovery are AIDCF-specific.

label: Security risk assessment for system design (system under consideration)
definition: Identification of the system under consideration is a context for the capability register and architecture linkage.

label: Security risk assessment for system design (target security levels)
definition: Consequence-based SL-T determination per zone overlaps criticality classification for OT; it does not define impact tolerance for Service Outcomes.

label: Secure product development lifecycle; Service provider security program
definition: Lifecycle security for products and integration services; commissioning acceptance of infrastructure capability is AIDCF-specific.

label: Technical security requirements for IACS components (software and firmware integrity and update)
definition: Component update integrity requirements are a context for accelerator firmware baselines; compatibility and rollback readiness are AIDCF-specific.

label: Security risk assessment for system design (zone and conduit model)
definition: Zone and conduit diagrams document OT communication dependencies; functional and recovery dependencies are AIDCF-specific.

label: Security program requirements for IACS service providers
definition: Service-provider security capability overlaps OEM dependency for control systems.

label: Zones and conduits; Restricted data flow
definition: Zones and conduits with enforced data-flow restrictions overlap boundary definition and cross-boundary enforcement for OT and control planes.

label: Security risk assessment for system design
definition: Structured risk assessment and SL-T/SL-A comparison are a context for assessment planning of OT controls.

label: SL-T, SL-C and SL-A
definition: Comparing achieved against target security level parallels gate evaluation for OT security; it is not an Assurance Decision.

label: Security program requirements for IACS asset owners
definition: The asset-owner security program establishes governance for IACS security; AIDCF GOV-01 governs the whole assurance methodology and Assurance Decisions.

label: Security program requirements for IACS asset owners
definition: Roles and responsibilities for IACS security overlap; critical-function accountability for non-OT infrastructure is out of scope.

label: Security program requirements for IACS asset owners
definition: IACS security policies and procedures overlap; engineering Technical Standard Baselines are out of scope.

label: Security program; Security risk assessment for system design
definition: IACS risk management overlaps; no Critical Gate governance.

label: Security program (training); Security program requirements for IACS service providers (personnel competence)
definition: Competence and training of IACS personnel; assessor independence and appeal are certification-scheme matters.

label: Restricted data flow
definition: Restricted data flow informs traffic isolation where storage or service networks connect to OT.

label: Identification and authentication control; Use control; Restricted data flow
definition: Management-network separation and controlled access overlap for OT; AI-fabric management networks are out of scope.

label: System integrity; Timely response to events
definition: Integrity and event response requirements are a context for configuration management and telemetry of OT networks.

label: Security program requirements for IACS service providers
definition: Service-provider personnel requirements; operational staffing is out of scope.

label: Security program (incident handling); Timely response to events
definition: IACS security incident handling overlaps; facility alarm management and non-security incidents are out of scope.

label: Security program (configuration and change); Service provider program
definition: IACS configuration and change management overlap; non-OT configuration is out of scope.

label: Security program (physical security of IACS)
definition: Physical protection of IACS assets is considered within the program; site access control is out of scope.

label: Zones and conduits
definition: Zones and conduits define containment boundaries for cyber propagation; physical and electrical fault domains are AIDCF-specific.

label: Resource availability (backup, recovery and reconstitution)
definition: System backup, recovery and reconstitution overlap configuration restoration for control systems.

label: Identification and authentication control; Use control; Component requirements
definition: Human and machine identity and privileged use control overlap strongly for IACS; break-glass governance requires explicit evaluation.

label: Security program; System security requirements; Component requirements
definition: BMS, EPMS and CDU control systems are IACS and are covered strongly. Cluster manager, fabric controller and storage controller security are outside the IACS scope.

label: Zones and conduits; Restricted data flow
definition: Security zoning, filtering and remote access via conduits overlap strongly for OT.

label: Security program (patch management); Secure product development lifecycle
definition: Patch and vulnerability management for IACS overlap (see also IEC TR 62443-2-3 on patch management); compensating controls where patching is constrained are characteristic of OT.

label: System integrity; Timely response to events
definition: Audit logging, event monitoring and response overlap; forensic readiness needs explicit evaluation.

label: Use control (authorisation enforcement)
definition: Authorisation enforcement applies to any actor, including automation; AI-agent authority, approval and allowlisting are AIDCF-specific.

label: Service provider security program; Secure product development lifecycle (maturity)
definition: Service-provider and product-supplier security capability overlap due diligence; financial resilience and sub-tier visibility are out of scope.

label: Security program requirements for IACS service providers
definition: Service-provider capabilities can be referenced in contracts; evidence and exit rights are AIDCF-specific.

label: Secure product development lifecycle; Component technical requirements
definition: Product integrity is a context; counterfeit prevention and chain of custody are not addressed.

label: Secure product development lifecycle (security update management); Component technical requirements (software authenticity)
definition: Security update management, authenticity of software and firmware and vulnerability handling overlap strongly for OT components.

label: Service provider remote access; Identification and authentication; Use control; Timely response to events
definition: Remote access by service providers and its control and monitoring overlap strongly.

label: Inventory of information and other associated assets
definition: The asset inventory is E1/E2 evidence for architecture linkage of Capability Instances; it does not define capabilities, owners at capability level or lifecycle status.

label: ICT readiness for business continuity
definition: Recovery objectives derived from business continuity requirements are a context for recovery outcomes; availability, performance and integrity outcomes with tolerances are not defined.

label: Information security risk assessment
definition: Consequence assessment informs criticality; impact tolerance per Service Outcome is not defined (ISO 22301 BIA is closer).

label: Capacity management
definition: Monitoring and adjusting resource use against current and expected capacity requirements overlaps demand baseline and growth forecast. Peak, transient and scenario demand for power and thermal are not addressed.

label: Security testing in development and acceptance; Change management; Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
definition: Acceptance testing, change management and disposal touch the capability lifecycle at component level; commissioning acceptance of infrastructure capability is not addressed.

label: Configuration management; Secure system architecture and engineering principles
definition: Configuration baselines and architecture principles overlap the approved compute baseline. Accelerator architecture and rack-scale composition are not addressed.

label: Redundancy of information processing facilities
definition: Redundancy at objective level; scale-up domain integrity and partitioning are not addressed.

label: Capacity management
definition: Capacity management overlaps usable capacity and reservation; scheduler controls and contention management are not addressed.

label: Management of technical vulnerabilities; Installation of software on operational systems; Change management
definition: Controlled installation and change overlap firmware and driver management; compatibility testing and rollback readiness are not specified.

label: Monitoring activities
definition: Security monitoring, not accelerator health, error and degradation detection.

label: Equipment maintenance; Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
definition: Maintenance and secure retirement overlap; provisioning, spares/RMA and node rebuild are not addressed.

label: Determining the scope of the ISMS (interfaces and dependencies)
definition: Scope determination considers interfaces and dependencies with other organisations; functional dependency mapping is not required.

label: Supplier relationships; Supplier agreements; Use of cloud services; Supporting utilities
definition: Supplier, cloud and utility dependency overlap at objective level. Utility capacity and telecom route dependency analysis are not addressed.

label: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
definition: Supply-chain management is a context; concentration and substitutability analysis are not required.

label: Scope of the ISMS; Use of cloud services; Segregation of networks
definition: ISMS scope, cloud shared-responsibility and network segregation overlap provider and tenant boundary. The AIDCF assessment boundary is defined per Capability Instance and decision question.

label: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
definition: Supplier service monitoring and change management overlap provider performance and change detection.

label: Protecting against physical and environmental threats; Equipment siting and protection
definition: Equipment siting considers environmental conditions; no envelope values or measurement requirements.

label: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
definition: Secure disposal addresses information on media, not hazardous materials or waste handling.

label: Understanding the organization and its context (climate change consideration)
definition: The 2024 amendment asks whether climate change is a relevant issue; climate adaptation and resource continuity measures are not addressed.

label: Documented information; Protection of records
definition: Documented information and record protection overlap evidence repository and retention; no evidence classes.

label: Control of documented information; Collection of evidence
definition: Evidence collection and preservation (A.5.28) overlaps integrity and custody; quality ratings are AIDCF-specific.

label: Internal audit
definition: Audit programme, criteria and scope overlap; decision questions and specialist testing are AIDCF-specific.

label: Nonconformity and corrective action
definition: Nonconformities map to Findings; no UNKNOWN Records or limitation disclosure.

label: Management review
definition: No gate evaluation or bounded claim language.

label: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation; Continual improvement
definition: Ongoing evaluation overlaps; evidence expiry and decision suspension are AIDCF-specific.

label: Leadership and commitment; Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities; Policies for information security
definition: ISMS leadership and governance overlap the governance charter. Decision rights over Assurance Decisions and methodology ownership are AIDCF-specific.

label: Roles and authorities; Information security risk treatment (risk-owner acceptance); Roles and responsibilities; Segregation of duties; Management responsibilities
definition: Role ownership, segregation of duties and risk-owner acceptance of residual risk overlap strongly. Critical Required Function accountability for facility systems is AIDCF-specific.

label: Policy; Documented information; Policies for information security; Compliance with policies, rules and standards; Documented operating procedures
definition: Policy hierarchy, document lifecycle and compliance with standards overlap. Engineering Technical Standard Baselines are outside scope.

label: Actions to address risks and opportunities; Internal audit; Management review; Independent review of information security
definition: Assurance planning and independent review overlap. No Critical Gate governance.

label: Needs and expectations of interested parties; Contact with authorities; Contact with special interest groups; Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
definition: Regulatory monitoring and stakeholder obligations overlap. Customer service commitments for infrastructure outcomes are not addressed.

label: Competence; Internal audit (auditor objectivity and impartiality); Information security awareness, education and training
definition: Competence and auditor impartiality overlap. Appeal and challenge of assessment results are not addressed.

label: Redundancy of information processing facilities
definition: No fabric topology, path diversity or oversubscription requirements.

label: Networks security; Security of network services; Segregation of networks
definition: Traffic isolation and service-network security overlap; storage-fabric performance is not addressed.

label: Privileged access rights; Segregation of networks
definition: Management-plane separation and privileged access overlap; OOB resilience and break-glass are not specified.

label: Cabling security
definition: Protection of power and telecommunications cabling overlaps; optics compatibility, cross-connect control and path documentation are not addressed.

label: Configuration management; Monitoring activities; Clock synchronization
definition: Configuration management and time synchronisation overlap; controller resilience and flow telemetry are not addressed.

label: Competence; Screening; Awareness, education and training
definition: Personnel security and competence; no 24x7 coverage or shift handover requirements.

label: Documented operating procedures
definition: Documented procedures overlap SOPs. Method statements, permit to work and lockout/tagout are outside scope.

label: Equipment maintenance
definition: Maintenance per supplier recommendations overlaps; condition monitoring, calibration and deferred-maintenance control are not specified.

label: Incident management planning; Assessment of events; Response to incidents; Learning from incidents; Event reporting
definition: Information-security incident management overlaps strongly. Facility alarm rationalisation and non-security incidents are outside scope.

label: Configuration management; Change management
definition: Configuration baselines and change management overlap strongly; temporary configuration control is not explicit.

label: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation; Capacity management
definition: Capacity monitoring overlaps; service-level monitoring and resource balancing are not addressed.

label: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
definition: Protection against natural and man-made threats overlaps site hazard assessment at objective level; no engineering criteria.

label: Protecting against physical and environmental threats; Equipment siting and protection
definition: No structural, rack-loading, anchorage or vibration requirements.

label: Physical security perimeters; Securing offices, rooms and facilities; Working in secure areas
definition: Security zoning overlaps. Fire and water zones and tenant segregation are not addressed.

label: Physical entry; Physical security monitoring
definition: Entry control and monitoring overlap strongly; alarm-response performance is not specified.

label: Return of assets; Security of assets off-premises; Storage media; Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
definition: Equipment movement, media custody and decommissioning custody overlap.

label: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
definition: Fire is one physical threat; detection, suppression interfaces, egress and emergency shutdown governance are governed by fire and building codes.

label: Supporting utilities
definition: Protection from power failures and utility disruption at objective level. Utility capacity, grid quality and connection reliability criteria are absent.

label: Supporting utilities
definition: Backup power is implied by supporting-utility protection; no generator or fuel criteria.

label: Supporting utilities
definition: No UPS topology, battery condition or runtime criteria.

label: Supporting utilities; Cabling security
definition: Power cabling protection only; no switchgear, selective coordination or earthing criteria.

label: Equipment maintenance
definition: Equipment maintenance applies generically; no EPMS coverage, switching procedures or black-start requirements.

label: Information security during disruption; ICT readiness for business continuity
definition: Continuity of security and ICT readiness; minimum service outcome and graceful degradation are not defined.

label: Redundancy of information processing facilities; Segregation of networks
definition: Redundancy and segregation contribute to containment; fault-domain definition and blast-radius limits are not required.

label: Information security during disruption; ICT readiness for business continuity
definition: ICT continuity overlaps continuity strategy and alternative capacity.

label: ICT readiness for business continuity; Information backup
definition: Recovery of ICT and data overlaps; recovery dependency and sequencing across power, cooling and control planes are not addressed.

label: ICT readiness for business continuity
definition: ICT readiness is to be tested; integrated scenario tests and lessons-and-retest are not specified.

label: Contact with authorities; Response to information security incidents
definition: Authority contact and incident response support crisis communications; crisis command and emergency change are not addressed.

label: Access control; Identity management; Authentication information; Access rights; Privileged access rights; Secure authentication
definition: Identity and privileged access overlap strongly for IT. Machine identity for OT and AI infrastructure and break-glass governance require explicit AIDCF evaluation.

label: Configuration management; Networks security; Secure system architecture and engineering principles
definition: Generic controls; BMS/EPMS, cluster manager, fabric and storage controller security are not addressed specifically. See the ISA/IEC 62443 crosswalk for OT.

label: Networks security; Security of network services; Segregation of networks; Web filtering
definition: Zoning, segmentation and filtering overlap strongly; management-plane segmentation for OT requires explicit evaluation.

label: Management of technical vulnerabilities; Configuration management; Installation of software on operational systems
definition: Vulnerability and patch management overlap strongly; exception and compensating control for OT patch constraints requires explicit evaluation.

label: Incident management; Assessment of events; Response; Collection of evidence; Logging; Monitoring activities
definition: Detection, response and forensic readiness overlap strongly for IT scope.

label: Privileged access rights; Use of privileged utility programs; Change management
definition: Privileged tooling and change control are a context; there is no concept of AI agent or automation authority.

label: Information backup
definition: Backup is one tier concern; training data, checkpoint and artefact tiering are not addressed.

label: Capacity management
definition: Capacity headroom overlaps; throughput, metadata performance and burst handling are not addressed.

label: Protection of records
definition: Record protection against falsification; no checksum, scrubbing or metadata-integrity requirements.

label: Information backup; Redundancy of information processing facilities
definition: Backup and redundancy overlap snapshot protection and replication; immutability and erasure-coding design are not specified.

label: Information backup; ICT readiness for business continuity
definition: Restore testing and ICT readiness overlap restart readiness; checkpoint durability for training jobs is not addressed.

label: Storage media; Secure disposal or re-use of equipment; Information deletion
definition: Secure sanitisation overlaps strongly; storage telemetry, media health and capacity forecasting are not addressed.

label: Information security in supplier relationships; ICT supply chain
definition: Supplier security posture overlaps; financial and operational resilience is not addressed.

label: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
definition: Supplier agreements overlap; evidence rights and exit rights should be checked explicitly against AIDCF SUP-02.

label: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
definition: ICT supply-chain processes overlap at objective level; counterfeit prevention and component traceability are not specified.

label: ICT supply chain; Technical vulnerabilities; Installation of software on operational systems
definition: Vulnerability response and controlled installation overlap; release provenance and signature validation are not specified.

label: Access control; Access rights; Privileged access rights; Logging
definition: Third-party access control and logging overlap; activation and approval of vendor remote sessions are not explicit.

label: Supporting utilities
definition: HVAC is a supporting utility at objective level; no heat-load model or resilient capacity criteria.

label: Supporting utilities
definition: No airflow or containment criteria.

label: Supporting utilities
definition: Water supply as a supporting utility; no heat-rejection criteria.

label: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
definition: Water damage as a physical threat; no coolant compatibility, leak detection or isolation criteria.

label: Equipment maintenance
definition: Generic maintenance; no control stability, sensor trust or thermal recovery requirements.

label: Resources for AI systems
definition: A.4 expects the organisation to identify and document resources for AI systems, including system and computing resources. AIDCF CAP-01 requires a register of bounded Capability Instances with owners, lifecycle status and architecture linkage.

label: AI objectives and planning to achieve them
definition: AI objectives concern the AI system; AIDCF Service Outcomes (availability, performance, integrity, recovery with tolerances) are infrastructure outcomes that support them.

label: AI system impact assessment; Assessing impacts of AI systems
definition: Impact assessment of AI systems on individuals and society informs stakeholder consequence and criticality of the infrastructure supporting them. It does not define infrastructure impact tolerances.

label: Resources for AI systems
definition: Resource documentation may record current compute allocation. Demand modelling (peak, transient, growth, scenario) is not addressed.

label: Planning of changes; Operational planning and control; AI system life cycle
definition: AI system lifecycle controls (design, verification, deployment, operation) are a context for infrastructure commissioning acceptance and material-change impact, but do not address them.

label: Resources for AI systems
definition: Records of system and computing resources produced under A.4 can corroborate the compute inventory (E1 evidence). They do not establish architecture adequacy or an approved baseline.

label: Resources for AI systems
definition: Resource provisioning for AI systems is a context for usable accelerator capacity; scheduler controls and contention management are not addressed.

label: Resources for AI systems
definition: Resource documentation can seed asset-to-function mapping. Upstream, downstream and recovery dependency mapping are not required.

label: Third-party and customer relationships; Operational planning and control (externally provided processes)
definition: Third-party relationships for AI systems overlap at objective level. Utility, telecom and OEM dependency of facility infrastructure is outside the AIMS scope unless deliberately included.

label: Determining the scope of the AI management system
definition: An AIMS scope statement is an input to, not a substitute for, the AIDCF assessment boundary, provider boundary and tenant boundary.

label: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation; Third-party and customer relationships
definition: General monitoring of the management system and third parties; no dependency health indicators or periodic revalidation of dependency maps.
42001 does not set energy-performance requirements; see EN 50600 and Singapore crosswalks.

label: Documented information
definition: Creation, control and retention of documented information overlap evidence taxonomy, repository and retention. 42001 has no evidence classes or quality model.

label: Documented information (control of documented information)
definition: Document control supports integrity and custody; provenance, relevance, reliability and currency ratings (AIDCF-008 P/F/C/R/T/I) are not addressed.

label: Internal audit
definition: Audit programme, criteria and scope overlap assessment planning. Decision questions, claim types and specialist technical testing are AIDCF-specific.

label: Nonconformity and corrective action
definition: Nonconformities map to Findings. 42001 has no concept equivalent to UNKNOWN Records, conflict handling or limitation disclosure.

label: Management review
definition: Management review takes decisions about the AIMS; it has no gate evaluation or bounded claim language.

label: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation; Continual improvement
definition: Ongoing evaluation and improvement overlap continuing assurance. Evidence expiry, change triggers and decision suspension are AIDCF-specific.

label: Leadership and commitment; Roles, responsibilities and authorities; Internal organization
definition: 42001 establishes top-management direction and roles for the AI management system. AIDCF GOV-01 additionally requires decision rights over infrastructure Assurance Decisions, committee oversight of gates and ownership of the assessment methodology.

label: Roles, responsibilities and authorities; Internal organization
definition: Role assignment for the AIMS overlaps RACI and role ownership. 42001 does not address accountability for Required Functions of facility infrastructure, risk-acceptance authority for gate outcomes or evidence custody.

label: AI policy; Documented information; Policies related to AI
definition: Policy hierarchy and document lifecycle overlap directly. Technical Standard Baselines for power, thermal, compute, storage and network engineering are outside 42001.

label: Actions to address risks and opportunities; Internal audit; Management review
definition: Risk-based planning and review of the management system align with assurance planning and independent review. 42001 has no equivalent of Critical Gate governance.

label: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties; Information for interested parties of AI systems
definition: Interested-party requirements (including regulatory and customer obligations) overlap. Infrastructure customer commitments (availability, recovery tolerances) are not specifically addressed.

label: Competence
definition: Competence overlaps. Conflict management, assessor independence and appeal are certification-body matters addressed by conformity-assessment standards rather than by 42001 itself.

label: Resources; Competence; Resources for AI systems (human resources)
definition: Resourcing and competence for the AIMS; no 24x7 coverage, shift handover or authorisation-to-operate requirements for facility operations.

label: Operational planning and control
definition: Operational control of AIMS processes; method statements, permit to work and lockout/tagout are outside scope.

label: Nonconformity and corrective action; Information for interested parties of AI systems
definition: Corrective action and communication about AI system incidents to interested parties are a context for incident and problem management. Alarm rationalisation and infrastructure incident response are not addressed.

label: Planning of changes
definition: Planned change to the management system; configuration baselines and rollback for infrastructure are not addressed.

label: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
definition: Generic performance evaluation; no capacity review or service-level monitoring of infrastructure.

label: Communication
definition: Determination of internal and external communication; crisis command and emergency change are not addressed.
42001 relies on the organisation's information-security management for access control; use the ISO/IEC 27001 crosswalk.

label: AI system life cycle; Use of AI systems
definition: 42001 governs responsible use of AI systems, including human oversight objectives. AIDCF SEC-06 applies this to AI agents or automation acting on infrastructure: bounded authority, approval controls, command allowlisting and safe rollback, which 42001 does not specify.

label: Data for AI systems
definition: A.7 addresses data acquisition, quality and provenance for AI systems, not the storage tiers that hold training data, checkpoints and artefacts.

label: Data for AI systems
definition: Data quality and provenance objectives are a context for storage data integrity; checksum, scrubbing and metadata integrity are not addressed.

label: Third-party and customer relationships
definition: Supplier responsibilities for AI systems overlap with supplier due diligence. Financial and operational resilience and sub-tier visibility of infrastructure suppliers are not addressed.

label: Third-party and customer relationships
definition: Allocation of responsibilities with suppliers and customers overlaps service obligations. Evidence rights, incident notification and exit rights are not specified.

label: Third-party and customer relationships
definition: No hardware provenance, counterfeit prevention or component traceability requirements.

label: Resources for AI systems (tooling); Third-party and customer relationships
definition: Tooling and third-party resources are documented; release provenance, signature validation and vulnerability response for firmware are not addressed.

label: Inventory of AI systems
definition: GOVERN 1.6 calls for an inventory of AI systems. AIDCF CAP-01 registers infrastructure Capability Instances; the AI system inventory can be linked as the demand-side consumer.

label: Context established; AI capabilities, targeted usage and goals understood
definition: Intended purpose and expected benefits of the AI system frame which infrastructure Service Outcomes matter; tolerances are not defined.

label: Context established; Impacts characterised
definition: Likelihood and magnitude of impacts inform criticality and stakeholder consequence; infrastructure impact tolerance is not defined.

label: Decommissioning and phasing out AI systems
definition: GOVERN 1.7 addresses safe decommissioning of AI systems; AIDCF CAP-06 addresses design-to-operation traceability, commissioning acceptance and retirement of infrastructure capability.

definition: Production monitoring of AI system behaviour sits above accelerator and node health telemetry; it can surface symptoms of infrastructure degradation.

label: Risks and benefits mapped for all components, including third-party
definition: Component-level risk mapping is the AI-system analogue of dependency discovery; upstream facility, recovery-only and downstream consequence paths are not addressed.

label: Third-party software, data and supply-chain risk; Management of third-party AI risks
